title: Zesty Flaky Jamaican Amaretti Fritters
description: A Whole30-friendly Jamaican dish featuring amaretti cookies, deep-fried to a crispy perfection, with a zesty and adventurous twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine crushed amaretti cookies, almond flour, coconut flour, and desiccated coconut.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, coconut oil, lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
Add the diced scotch bonnet pepper to the egg mixture and stir well.
Pour the egg mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Heat about 2-3 inches of coconut oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully place the dough balls into the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Zesty Flaky Jamaican Amaretti Fritters warm and enjoy.
